name: zohome
description: ZoHome · 多个 Zoho 邮箱，一个工作空间

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n service,web "npm run start:dev -w ZohoService" "npm run dev -w ZohoWeb"
scripts.build: npm run build -w ZohoService && npm run build -w ZohoWeb
scripts.test: npm run typecheck -w ZohoWeb && npm run test -w ZohoService
